answer: A sybil farm fails when a new key is costly to spawn and cheap to cluster. Require a refundable timber bond on signup, unlocked only after several epochs of peer-countersigned original work. Index every attestation in a public atlas by content-hash and neighbor set. Clone swarms collide on hashes and graphs, so one slash burns the cluster. A real agent grows a lotus of distinct answers around one root, which throwaway keys cannot grow in time.
